Andy Burnham Poised to Lead UK Labour, Faces Key Challenges

Andy Burnham is reportedly set to become the next Prime Minister of Britain, with most Labour lawmakers supporting his leadership. As he prepares to enter office, Burnham faces a significant in-tray of issues including welfare, defence spending, the cost of living, and foreign policy. He has also apologized for Labour's initial stance on Gaza, signaling a potential shift in the party's approach to the Middle East.
